headline: A Houthi missile attack hit Saudi Aramco's Dhahran headquarters on Tuesday and started a fire, the first reported strike on Aramco's corporate core. Reuters reports Saudi Arabia now plans a hybrid format for FII10 (26–29 Oct) after the airport attacks. The Digital Government Authority disclosed almost SR32bn of government ICT spend and seven framework agreements worth more than SR60bn, while about half the grid is being upgraded partly for AI. Memory stayed tight: DDR5 16Gb spot reached $60.10, J.P. Morgan sees a 19% shortfall in 2027, and Morgan Stanley warns memory stocks may be near their peak.
lenovo_read: Protect people and continuity first, re-plan FII10 for a hybrid format with pre-booked meetings, and shift commercial focus to the DGA framework agreements where government ICT spend is contracted.

pillars.dc: 1 scored: Saudi grid upgrade (about 50% of the grid, partly for AI and data centres). No KSA, GCC, Türkiye or Pakistan DC build or PPA first published in window; Iran's threat to Gulf DCs appears only in explainers.
pillars.memory: 4 scored: J.P. Morgan shortfall forecast (via Musk), Morgan Stanley peak warning, Samsung/SK hynix sell-off on CXMT, ASML Q3. DRAMeXchange DDR5 16Gb spot $60.100 (+0.33%) on 14 Oct; no new contract print.
pillars.deals: 6 scored: Dell–Tahaluf (UAE), e& UAE–DataRobot, Sharjah Digital–AWS, Muscat unified municipal system, Hikvision–Aramco, Tencent Cloud–Dubai CommerCity. No GCC funding round of $20M or more and no Tadawul ICT award in window.
pillars.global: Dell, AWS and Hikvision META moves scored; Chinese rule: Tencent (UAE) and Huawei (MTN South Africa). Global: DoJ case against a Saudi OpenAI engineer; Bot Auto picks Lenovo AD1.

stories.title: Aramco's Dhahran headquarters hit during Houthi missile attack on Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: Sources say a Houthi missile attack hit Aramco's Dhahran headquarters and started a fire that was put out; damage is unclear. SPA cites a limited fire at an administrative building and no casualties.
bullets: Saudi Aramco's headquarters in Dhahran was hit during a Houthi missile attack on Tuesday, starting a fire in part of the complex that sources say has been put out
The Saudi-led coalition said Houthi missiles targeted several cities including Riyadh and Dhahran, with shrapnel from an interception falling in a residential area of Dhahran
Aramco and the Saudi energy ministry did not respond to requests for comment, and a Jazan refinery remains shut since an earlier attack
stories.lenovo: Lenovo's largest KSA energy account has its corporate IT core exposed. Continuity and DR now sit inside Aramco and Aramco Digital, where Dell already holds a resilience MoU (OPP-061/068); approach through account channels only.
stories.arabic: أفادت مصادر بأن هجوماً صاروخياً حوثياً أصاب مقر أرامكو في الظهران وأشعل حريقاً جرى إخماده، فيما أعلنت وزارة الطاقة عن حريق محدود في مبنى إداري دون إصابات.

stories.title: EXCLUSIVE-Saudi Arabia plans hybrid format for marquee FII conference after attacks, sources say
stories.summary: Two sources say FII10 will become a hybrid event so executives can attend remotely; some delegates may land at airstrips outside Riyadh or in neighbouring Gulf states. Oil executives withdrew from WPC.
bullets: Saudi Arabia plans to turn the Future Investment Initiative into a hybrid event so executives can attend remotely, two people familiar with the matter said
Some participants are still expected in person, possibly landing at airstrips outside Riyadh or in neighbouring Gulf states and driving to the capital
A draft programme dated October 6 listed Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon, Standard Chartered CEO Bill Winters and Citi CEO Jane Fraser as speakers
stories.lenovo: A hybrid FII10 shrinks the in-person room. CEO-level HUMAIN and PIF-portfolio meetings now need pre-booked in-Kingdom slots; decide the attendance mix this week (OPP-075).
stories.arabic: تفيد مصادر لرويترز بأن السعودية تعتزم عقد مبادرة مستقبل الاستثمار هذا الشهر بصيغة هجينة تتيح المشاركة عن بعد، بعد الهجمات على مطار الرياض.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia upgrading 50% of power grid as demand climbs from industry to AI
stories.summary: Saudi Power Procurement says about half the grid is being expanded, including for AI and data centres. DGA reports almost SR32bn of government ICT spend and seven framework agreements worth more than SR60bn.
bullets: Mazin Al-Bahkali, CEO of Saudi Power Procurement Co., said about half of the grid is being expanded to meet growing demand, including from AI and data centers
Anas Al-Rimi of the Digital Government Authority said government ICT spending reached almost SR32 billion ($8.52 billion), with spending on emerging AI technologies up 20 percent
Seven framework agreements covering more than SR60 billion in spending across over 100 service providers are active, and the authority plans to reach 2,400 AI services by the end of this year
stories.lenovo: The DGA framework agreements are the contracting route for government ICT; Lenovo SKUs must be on them directly or through listed SIs (new OPP-078). The grid upgrade removes the main constraint on KSA AI data centres.
stories.arabic: أكد الرئيس التنفيذي للشركة السعودية لشراء الطاقة توسعة نحو نصف الشبكة الكهربائية لتلبية الطلب بما فيه الذكاء الاصطناعي، فيما بلغ الإنفاق الحكومي على التقنية نحو 32 مليار ريال عبر سبع اتفاقيات إطارية تتجاوز 60 مليار ريال.

stories.title: Saudi Energy Ministry using AI to calculate disruptions before they hit
stories.summary: The Ministry of Energy uses AI and real-time data, including fuel-station data, to anticipate disruptions and simulate incidents. HUMAIN and SDAIA are named partners.
bullets: The Ministry of Energy uses AI and real-time data to anticipate disruptions, said Alanoud Al-Shuraym, general manager of enterprise architecture, at the 25th WPC Energy Congress in Riyadh
The ministry integrated fuel station data into its monitoring center, and its systems can simulate incidents and assess their impact across the energy value chain
The ministry has partnered with HUMAIN and the Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority, among others, to support localization and safe AI integration
stories.lenovo: Real-time monitoring under wartime conditions means on-premises analytics compute, edge at sites and resilient storage (ISG/SSG). Approach through HUMAIN's partner channel (links OPP-012).
stories.arabic: تستخدم وزارة الطاقة الذكاء الاصطناعي والبيانات الآنية للتنبؤ بالاضطرابات ومحاكاة أثرها على سلسلة القيمة، بالشراكة مع هيوماين وسدايا.

stories.title: Hikvision and Aramco sign Memorandum of Understanding to explore AI-driven environmental monitoring and biodiversity solutions
stories.summary: Hikvision and Aramco will explore AI and advanced imaging for vegetation health, fauna assessment and environmental analytics. No value or timeline was given.
bullets: Hikvision and Aramco signed an MoU to explore AI and advanced imaging for environmental monitoring, biodiversity protection and other sustainability initiatives
The proposed scope includes AI-enabled native vegetation health monitoring, fauna assessment and monitoring, environmental data analytics and knowledge sharing
The collaboration may also explore joint research, technical workshops and digital solutions for environmental assessment and monitoring
stories.lenovo: A Chinese vision-AI vendor gains an Aramco reference through a low-sensitivity use case. Edge AI cameras and analytics overlap with ThinkEdge; fold into the OPP-048 counter-brief.
stories.arabic: وقعت هيكفيجن وأرامكو مذكرة تفاهم لاستكشاف حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي والتصوير المتقدم في الرصد البيئي وحماية التنوع الأحيائي.

stories.title: Dell Technologies and Tahaluf Partner on AI Solutions for UAE Smart Cities
stories.summary: Dell and Tahaluf signed an MoU pairing Dell AI and edge computing with Tahaluf's in-vehicle platform for UAE smart-city and public-safety services. Signed at AI Everything; no value.
bullets: Dell Technologies and Tahaluf Al Emarat Technical Solutions signed an MoU to develop AI-powered solutions for UAE public-sector urban services and public safety
The agreement was signed at AI Everything in Abu Dhabi by Walid Yehia, Managing Director South Gulf at Dell Technologies, and Dr. Ahmed Musabbeh Al Kaabi, CEO of Tahaluf
The partnership pairs Dell's AI and edge computing with Tahaluf's in-vehicle technology platform for onboard processing and operational data workflows
stories.lenovo: Dell is building a UAE public-sector edge-AI reference in ThinkEdge territory, after its Aramco Digital and National Vault deals. Counter with a second-source edge reference (new OPP-079).
stories.arabic: وقعت دل تكنولوجيز وتحالف مذكرة تفاهم لتطوير حلول ذكاء اصطناعي وحوسبة طرفية على متن المركبات لدعم خدمات المدن الذكية والسلامة العامة في الإمارات.

stories.title: Etisalat UAE and DataRobot deepen strategic partnership to advance sovereign agentic AI
stories.summary: A new multi-year agreement will host the DataRobot Agent Workforce Platform in Etisalat UAE's own data centre, keeping AI workloads on self-managed infrastructure.
bullets: The companies signed a new multi-year agreement to build, run and govern AI agents across Etisalat UAE's business units
Etisalat UAE will host the DataRobot Agent Workforce Platform in its own data centre, keeping sensitive data and AI workloads on infrastructure it manages
The partnership began in 2022 with predictive projects such as churn prevention and credit risk optimization
stories.lenovo: On-premises agentic AI at e& UAE needs GPU inference servers and storage; the vendor is undisclosed, so this is an open ISG opportunity (new OPP-080).
stories.arabic: وقعت اتصالات الإمارات وداتا روبوت اتفاقية متعددة السنوات لتشغيل وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي على بنية تحتية ذاتية الإدارة داخل مركز بيانات الشركة.

stories.title: Sharjah Digital Department and Amazon Web Services sign MoU to strengthen digital capabilities and government innovation
stories.summary: Sharjah Digital and AWS signed an MoU at AWS Summit 2026 covering AI and cloud training for government staff and expertise sharing on data classification and privacy.
bullets: The MoU was signed on the sidelines of AWS Summit 2026 by Sheikh Saud bin Sultan Al Qasimi, Director General of SDD, and Chris Erasmus, General Manager for the UAE and Rest of MENA at AWS
The partners will cooperate on specialised training programmes to develop government professionals' skills in artificial intelligence and cloud computing
The cooperation covers exchanging expertise on technology policies, data classification and data privacy
stories.lenovo: AWS is anchoring Sharjah through skills and policy. Watch the data-classification outcome: classified tiers need on-premises infrastructure (ISG/SSG).
stories.arabic: وقعت دائرة الشارقة الرقمية وأمازون ويب سيرفيسز مذكرة تفاهم لتدريب الكوادر الحكومية على الذكاء الاصطناعي والحوسبة السحابية وتبادل الخبرات في سياسات البيانات.

stories.title: بلدية مسقط توقع اتفاقية مشروع النظام البلدي الموحد
stories.summary: Muscat Municipality signed with an Ithca Group subsidiary for a unified digital platform for municipal services across Oman's governorates, built on geospatial data. No value or duration given.
bullets: وقّع الاتفاقية رئيس بلدية مسقط المهندس أحمد بن سعيد العامري، وعن شركة تابعة لمجموعة إذكاء المهندس طالب بن حمود الراشدي الرئيس التنفيذي للمجموعة بالوكالة
يهدف المشروع إلى جمع الخدمات البلدية في مختلف محافظات السلطنة على منصة رقمية واحدة تشمل تراخيص البناء وعقود الإيجار والتصاريح
يعتمد المشروع على الأنظمة الجغرافية المكانية لتوحيد البيانات البلدية ويمهّد لاستخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي بما يتماشى مع رؤية عُمان 2040
stories.lenovo: A national government platform build with hardware undisclosed. The Ithca Group integrator will buy compute, storage and endpoints (ISG/IDG; new OPP-081).
stories.arabic: وقعت بلدية مسقط اتفاقية مع شركة تابعة لمجموعة إذكاء لتنفيذ النظام البلدي الموحد الذي يجمع الخدمات البلدية في محافظات السلطنة على منصة رقمية واحدة.

stories.title: Dubai CommerCity and Tencent Cloud strengthen digital economy competitiveness and accelerate digital commerce growth
stories.summary: Dubai CommerCity signed with Tencent Cloud in Shenzhen to give its free-zone companies access to Tencent Cloud products, with joint events and hackathons.
bullets: Dubai CommerCity signed the agreement with Tencent Cloud at Tencent's headquarters in Shenzhen during a delegation visit led by Director General Amna Lootah
Tencent Cloud will make its products and services available to companies registered in DCC
The collaboration includes events, exhibitions, hackathons and workshops, supporting Dubai's Economic Agenda D33
stories.lenovo: Tencent Cloud is using UAE free zones to reach SMB and e-commerce customers, competing with Lenovo SSG hybrid-cloud and DaaS bundles in free-zone channels.
stories.arabic: وقعت دبي كومرسيتي اتفاقية مع تينسنت كلاود في شنتشن لإتاحة خدماتها السحابية وحلول الذكاء الاصطناعي للشركات المسجلة في المنطقة الحرة.

stories.title: Türk Telekom Reshapes Senior IT and Corporate Risk Leadership
stories.summary: Türk Telekom's IT Assistant GM and Head of Corporate Risk are leaving; Bilal Topal becomes acting IT AGM and Oğuzhan Şatıroğlu Head of Corporate Risk.
bullets: IT Assistant General Manager Gökhan Evren and Head of Corporate Risk Serdar Toraman are leaving their roles
Bilal Topal, previously Legal Collections Director, has been named acting IT Assistant General Manager
Oğuzhan Şatıroğlu, previously Executive and CEO General Governance Coordinator, has been named Head of Corporate Risk
stories.lenovo: A new IT decision-maker at a Lenovo ISG Türkiye account; re-engage at executive level within 30 days.
stories.arabic: أعلنت ترك تيليكوم تعيين بلال طوبال مساعداً للمدير العام لتقنية المعلومات بالإنابة وأوغوزهان شاتير أوغلو رئيساً للمخاطر المؤسسية.

stories.title: MTN hits 10Gbit/s wireless speeds in South African 5G-Advanced trial
stories.summary: MTN reached 10.35 Gbit/s in a single-site 5G-Advanced trial using 400 MHz of upper 6 GHz spectrum and Huawei equipment, under a temporary ICASA licence.
bullets: MTN reported a peak download speed of 10.35Gbit/s in a 5G-Advanced trial at a single site at its Johannesburg headquarters
The trial used 400MHz in the upper 6GHz band under a temporary radio licence from Icasa, and no operator has yet been assigned any of the band
MTN worked with Huawei, using a standalone 5G core and beamforming wideband antennas
stories.lenovo: Huawei keeps its RAN and core incumbency at MTN, which tends to pull Huawei into edge and DC refreshes. Lenovo's opening at MTN is on the IT side (ThinkEdge MEC, telco cloud).
stories.arabic: حققت MTN سرعة 10.35 غيغابت في الثانية في تجربة لشبكات الجيل الخامس المتقدم بجنوب أفريقيا باستخدام معدات هواوي ونطاق 6 غيغاهيرتز.

stories.title: Saudi National Arrested for Installing Surreptitious Audio Recording Device at OpenAI
stories.summary: The DoJ charged a Saudi national and OpenAI engineer with intercepting oral communications after recording devices were found in an executive conference room. The release names no Saudi entity.
bullets: Abdulrahman Alfozan, 35, a Saudi national and OpenAI engineer since July 2025, was arrested on October 9 and made his initial federal court appearance on October 13
A device hidden in toilet paper was discovered about September 30 in a USB port on a television in an executive conference room in San Francisco
The charge carries a maximum of 5 years in prison and a $250,000 fine, and the case involves the National Security Division's Counterintelligence and Export Control Section
stories.lenovo: Adds US policy friction to KSA AI technology flows; expect tougher end-use and personnel diligence on US-origin GPU servers. Keep export-compliance documentation ready for HUMAIN-class deals; no external comment.
stories.arabic: أعلنت وزارة العدل الأمريكية توقيف مهندس سعودي في أوبن إيه آي بتهمة زرع جهاز تسجيل صوتي سري في قاعة اجتماعات تنفيذية بمقر الشركة في سان فرانسيسكو.

stories.title: Bot Auto Selects Lenovo AD1 built on NVIDIA Hyperion to Scale Driverless Trucking
stories.summary: Bot Auto chose Lenovo's AD1 domain controller on NVIDIA Hyperion as production compute for its Class 8 driverless trucks from Q1 2027.
bullets: Bot Auto chose Lenovo's AD1 domain controller, built on NVIDIA Hyperion, as the production compute platform for its Class 8 driverless trucks, with integration beginning in Q1 2027
Bot Auto expects total autonomous-driving hardware cost, including compute and sensors, of $50,000 per truck
The AD1 is rated for continuous operation from -40°C to 85°C and delivers up to 2,000 FP4 TFLOPS of AI compute
stories.lenovo: A production design win for Lenovo vehicle compute and a ready reference for KSA and UAE autonomous logistics: NEOM and Oxagon, Mawani, mining haulage (ISG edge).
stories.arabic: اختارت شركة Bot Auto منصة لينوفو AD1 المبنية على NVIDIA Hyperion حوسبةً إنتاجية لشاحناتها ذاتية القيادة اعتباراً من الربع الأول 2027.

stories.title: Musk Blasts Memory Chipmakers Over "Extortionate" Pricing, Praises Micron
stories.summary: Musk called some memory suppliers' prices extortionate while praising Micron, replying to J.P. Morgan forecasts of a 19% memory shortfall in 2027 and HBM reaching $280bn by 2028.
bullets: Elon Musk said on X that Micron had been reasonable about future memory prices while other suppliers had demanded "extortionate prices"
J.P. Morgan projected a memory chip supply shortfall of about 20% this year, 19% in 2027 and 15% in 2028, with the HBM market growing from about $64 billion to $280 billion in 2028
According to J.P. Morgan, Micron has secured 26 long-term supply contracts and committed more than 75% of its fiscal 2027 output
stories.lenovo: The 2027 shortfall barely eases and large buyers are locking long-term agreements now. META's 2027 PC and server pipeline needs allocation confirmed against named deals (OPP-045/069).
stories.arabic: انتقد إيلون ماسك أسعار موردي الذاكرة ووصفها بالباهظة مشيداً بمايكرون، فيما توقع جي بي مورغان عجزاً في المعروض بنحو 19% في 2027.

stories.title: 記憶體越賺越要小心 大摩提醒股價往往比獲利先見頂
stories.summary: Morgan Stanley warns Samsung and SK hynix at 3–4x forward P/E may be a peak-cycle valuation trap; memory stocks historically peak 4–8 months before earnings. It expects HBM prices to rise through 2027.
bullets: 大摩認為，三星與SK海力士約3至4倍的遠期本益比，可能正是週期股接近獲利高峰時的估值陷阱
2008年與2012年，相關股票均比獲利高峰提早約4個月見頂；2018年，時間差更擴大至約8個月
若要支撐目前股價隱含的進一步上漲空間，DRAM合約價仍需較上季上漲約70%，實現難度很高
stories.lenovo: The second credible house to flag a near-peak conventional-memory cycle, against J.P. Morgan's 2027 shortfall. Index Q4 and Q1 quotes but avoid fixed multi-year memory commitments at peak.
stories.arabic: حذر مورغان ستانلي من أن أسهم الذاكرة تبلغ ذروتها عادة قبل الأرباح بأربعة إلى ثمانية أشهر، مع توقع استمرار ارتفاع أسعار HBM حتى 2027 ودخول طاقات جديدة في النصف الثاني من 2027.

stories.title: Samsung, SK Hynix Sink on CXMT DRAM Tease
stories.summary: Samsung fell 7.39% and SK hynix 10.09% after CXMT teased a 4F² DRAM design. Korean analysts see a 1.5–2 generation gap and no short-term easing of the shortage.
bullets: CXMT teased a 4F² DRAM design it says reduces memory cell area by 33% versus the mainstream 6F² method, without disclosing specifications or a release timeline
Samsung Electronics fell 7.39% and SK Hynix fell 10.09% on Oct. 13

Shin Seung-yoon of Hanwha Investment & Securities estimated a 1.5 to 2 generation technology gap, while Kim Byung-yeon of NH Investment & Securities said CXMT will struggle to resolve the supply shortage in the short term without ASML EUV equipment
stories.lenovo: No 2027 supply relief, but Chinese DRAM is now credible. Expect OEM qualification pressure and compliance questions; ISG and IDG product management should hold a CXMT position.
stories.arabic: تراجعت أسهم سامسونج وإس كيه هاينكس بعد إعلان CXMT الصينية تقنية ذاكرة 4F² تقلص مساحة الخلية 33%، فيما يرى محللون أن الفجوة التقنية لا تزال جيلاً ونصفاً إلى جيلين.

stories.title: ASML reports €11.7 billion total net sales and €5.0 billion net income in Q3 2026
stories.summary: ASML's Q3 net sales were about €11.7bn with €5.0bn net income; it guides €44–45bn for 2026 and says planned 2027–28 supply will not fully meet demand.
bullets: Q3 2026 net sales were about €11.7 billion with a 57.5% gross margin, and net income was about €5.0 billion
ASML expects Q4 2026 net sales of €14.2 to €15.2 billion and full-year 2026 net sales of €44 to €45 billion
CEO Christophe Fouquet said supply planned for 2027 and 2028 "will not fully meet the demand of our customers"
stories.lenovo: Upstream capacity stays short through 2028, supporting the view that memory and advanced-node costs stay high into 2027. Keep price-protection clauses across META bids (OPP-069).
stories.arabic: حققت ASML مبيعات بنحو 11.7 مليار يورو في الربع الثالث 2026، وأكدت أن الإمدادات المخططة لعامي 2027 و2028 لن تلبي طلب العملاء بالكامل.

opportunities.account: KSA energy and government accounts – business continuity and DR
opportunities.title: Measured DR and continuity offer after the Riyadh Aramco strike
opportunities.why_now: Aramco's Dhahran headquarters was hit on 13 Oct, the first strike on the corporate core, after the 10 Oct airport strikes. Dell already holds a resilience narrative at Aramco Digital.
opportunities.entry_point: Existing Aramco and Aramco Digital executive sponsors only: secondary-site compute and storage outside the Eastern Province, immutable backup, in-Kingdom spares from Riyadh and ALAT stock.
opportunities.owner: ISG KSA energy account lead with SSG KSA services lead

opportunities.account: FII10 executive meeting slate – HUMAIN, PIF portfolio, MCIT/SDAIA
opportunities.title: Decide FII10 attendance and book HUMAIN, PIF-portfolio and MCIT executive meetings
opportunities.why_now: Reuters reports FII10 will go hybrid, with delegates routed via outlying airstrips; hallway access shrinks, so pre-booked meetings decide who gets time.
opportunities.entry_point: RHQ executive office locks HUMAIN, PIF-portfolio CIO and MCIT/SDAIA meetings in Riyadh, with global executives joining remotely.
opportunities.owner: RHQ executive office with the ISG KSA HUMAIN account lead

opportunities.account: Digital Government Authority – ICT framework agreements (SR60bn+, 100+ providers)
opportunities.title: Get Lenovo and ALAT-made SKUs onto DGA's government ICT framework agreements
opportunities.why_now: DGA disclosed almost SR32bn of government ICT spend, AI spend up 20%, and seven active framework agreements worth more than SR60bn across 100+ providers.
opportunities.entry_point: DGA technology and solutions sector (Deputy Governor Anas Al-Rimi's office); map framework holders carrying Lenovo; LCGPA certification for ALAT-made SKUs.
opportunities.owner: KSA public-sector account director with government affairs and the IDG KSA channel lead

opportunities.account: UAE public-sector smart-city edge AI – counter Dell–Tahaluf
opportunities.title: Second-source ThinkEdge reference for UAE smart-city and public-safety programmes
opportunities.why_now: Dell signed an in-vehicle edge-AI MoU with Tahaluf for UAE smart cities, its third GCC government resilience or edge reference in three weeks.
opportunities.entry_point: Tahaluf (non-exclusive MoU); Abu Dhabi and Dubai municipal and police smart-mobility programmes; Sharjah Digital.

opportunities.account: e& UAE – on-premises sovereign agentic-AI infrastructure (DataRobot)
opportunities.title: GPU inference servers and storage for e& UAE's self-hosted DataRobot agent platform
opportunities.why_now: e& UAE will host the DataRobot Agent Workforce Platform in its own data centre under a new multi-year deal; the hardware vendor is undisclosed.
opportunities.entry_point: e& UAE enterprise IT and data-centre infrastructure team; DataRobot partner team for a validated ThinkSystem GPU reference.
opportunities.owner: ISG UAE telco account lead with the alliances manager

opportunities.account: Muscat Municipality – unified municipal system (Ithca Group / Al Taqnia Al Raida)
opportunities.title: Platform compute, storage and endpoints via the Ithca Group integrator
opportunities.why_now: Contract signed 13 Oct for a nationwide municipal digital platform on geospatial data; hardware undisclosed.
opportunities.entry_point: Al Taqnia Al Raida (Ithca Group) as integrator and potential channel partner; Muscat Municipality IT.
opportunities.owner: Lenovo Oman country manager with ISG pre-sales

opportunities.account: META open bids – Q4 memory pass-through
opportunities.title: Re-validate Q4 quotes and make memory indexation standard in multi-year deals
opportunities.why_now: DDR5 spot is $60.10, J.P. Morgan sees a 19% shortfall in 2027, Morgan Stanley warns memory stocks are near peak, and ASML says supply is short through 2028.
opportunities.entry_point: META deal desk and pricing leads; global memory procurement for 2027 allocation.
